posts.title: {I've Been Reading} We Were Never Meant to Survive This
posts.description: Trad Wife by Sarah Langan If this isn't the best of the "trad wife" thrillers, it's darn close. The prologue makes it immediately clear that this is folk horror and then the book spends a lot of time introducing the reader to Jenny, a journalist who is just desperate enough to accept an assignment travelling to Black Swan Farm to write about Mia Wright, one of the most popular influencers online.

posts.title: {I've Been Reading} Murder in the Upper Crust
posts.description: Murder in the Upper Crust by Mindy Quigley I've been reading the Deep Dish mystery series since the first book and as soon as I see that a new one is coming out, I add it to my to-be-read pile.
